label: TP
reason: User input flows through Base64 encode/decode roundtrip (which preserves the input) into bar, which concatenates with TESTFILES_DIR to form fileName. This fileName is used in new File() constructor which opens FileInputStream for reading arbitrary files. The HTML encoding protects the output display but does not prevent the file system access vulnerability. Path traversal is possible via ../ sequences in user input.

evidence.note: user input flows to fileName which controls file path
